papers.title: Selective laser melting of Ni-rich NiTi: selection of process parameters and the superelastic response
papers.abstract: Material and mechanical properties of NiTi shape memory alloys strongly depend on the fabrication process parameters and the resulting microstructure. In selective laser melting, the combination of parameters such as laser power, scanning speed, and hatch spacing determine the microstructural defects, grain size and texture. Therefore, processing parameters can be adjusted to tailor the microstructure and mechanical response of the alloy. In this work, NiTi samples were fabricated using Ni50.8Ti (at.%) powder via SLM PXM by Phenix/3D Systems and the effects of processing parameters were systematically studied. The relationship between the processing parameters and superelastic properties were investigated thoroughly. It will be shown that energy density is not the only parameter that governs the material response. It will be shown that hatch spacing is the dominant factor to tailor the superelastic response. It will be revealed that with the selection of right process parameters, perfect superelasticity with recoverable strains of up to 5.6% can be observed in the as-fabricated condition.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了用于生物医学的NiTi合金的SLM工艺参数，但未涉及应力遮挡、多孔结构、疲劳或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on superelasticity of NiTi, but does not address porous structure for stiffness matching, stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺参数对NiTi超弹性的影响
summary_zh.method: 系统改变激光功率、扫描速度、间距制备NiTi样品
summary_zh.result: 发现间距是控制超弹性响应的关键因素，可获得5.6%可恢复应变
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试验证超弹性性能

summary_en.motivation: To understand the effect of selective laser melting process parameters on the superelastic response of Ni-rich NiTi.
summary_en.method: Systematically varied laser power, scanning speed, and hatch spacing to fabricate NiTi samples.
summary_en.result: Hatch spacing was identified as the dominant factor controlling superelasticity, achieving recoverable strains up to 5.6%.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing of as-fabricated samples for superelastic performance.

papers.title: Influence of SLM on compressive response of NiTi scaffolds
papers.abstract: Porous Nickel-Titanium shape memory alloys (NiTi-SMAs) have attracted much attention in biomedical applications due to their high range of pure elastic deformability (i.e., superelasticity) as well as their bone-level modulus of elasticity (E≈12-20 GPa). In recent years, Selective Laser Melting (SLM) has been used to produce complex NiTi components. The focus of this study is to investigate the superelasticity and compressive properties of SLM NiTi-SMAs. To this aim, several NiTi components with different level of porosities (32- 58%) were fabricated from Ni50.8Ti (at. %) powder via SLM PXM by Phenix/3D Systems, using optimum processing parameter (Laser power-P=250 W, scanning speed-v=1250mm/s, hatch spacing-h=120μm, layer thickness-t=30μm). To tailor the superelasticity behavior at body temperature, the samples were solution annealed and aged for 15 min at 350°C. Then, transformation temperatures (TTs), superelastic response, and cyclic behavior of NiTi samples were studied. As the porosity was increased, the irrecoverable strain was observed to be higher in the samples. At the first superelastic cycle, 3.5%, 3.5%, and 2.7% strain recovery were observed for the porosity levels of 32%, 45%, and 58%, respectively. However, after 10 cycles, the superelastic response of the samples was stabilized and full strain recovery was observed. Finally, the modulus of elasticity of dense SLM NiTi was decreased from 47 GPa to 9 GPa in the first cycle by adding 58% porosity.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制备的多孔NiTi支架的超弹性和压缩性能，实现了骨匹配刚度，但未涉及疲劳寿命和表面形态，与用户对AM生物材料的方向部分相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover fatigue testing beyond 10 cycles, surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration, limiting its completeness for implant validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备的多孔NiTi支架超弹性和压缩性能，以实现骨匹配刚度。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备不同孔隙率(32-58%)的NiTi试样，热处理后测试超弹性响应和循环行为。
summary_zh.result: 孔隙率增加导致不可恢复应变增大，但循环后超弹性稳定，弹性模量从47 GPa降至9 GPa。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩试验和10次循环测试验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the superelasticity and compressive properties of SLM-fabricated porous NiTi scaffolds for bone-matching stiffness.
summary_en.method: NiTi scaffolds with varying porosities (32-58%) were fabricated via SLM, solution annealed and aged, then tested for superelastic response and cyclic behavior.
summary_en.result: Higher porosity increased irrecoverable strain, but after 10 cycles superelasticity stabilized; modulus decreased from 47 GPa to 9 GPa with 58% porosity.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical compression and cyclic testing on fabricated scaffolds.

papers.title: Advances in Short-Stem Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.abstract: Total hip arthroplasty (THA) is one of the most successful procedures of the last century providing excellent long-term results. In modern THA, however, not only the choice of approach determines the postoperative outcome, but also the type of implant. Short stems have already been developed decades ago, in order to ensure bone and soft-tissue sparing implantation. Because of the heterogeneity of different short-stem designs, a universally applicable classification seems necessary. Shortening of a conventional stem might change its biomechanical properties and doesn't correspond to the philosophy of modern short stems of the latest generation. Unlike conventional straight stems with classical diaphyseal anchorage, short stems focus on anchoring in the metaphysis. Indications for short-stem THA have been constantly expanding in the last few years. Originally short stems were developed and thus have been primarily used in young, active osteoarthritis patients with high demands regarding postoperative function.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了短柄THA的发展与分类，未涉及应力遮挡或有限元定量分析。
llm.why_not_core: This clinical review paper does not provide any biomechanical simulation data, stress shielding quantification, or micromotion analysis for hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述短柄THA的发展与分类，以应对设计异质性。
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾短柄设计哲学与临床适应症。
summary_zh.result: 短柄THA适应症已扩展至年轻活动量大患者。

summary_en.motivation: To review the development and classification of short-stem THA to address design heterogeneity.
summary_en.method: A systematic review of short-stem design philosophy and clinical indications.
summary_en.result: Indications for short-stem THA have expanded to young, active patients.
summary_en.validation: None, as this is a literature review.

papers.title: Factors related to disagreement in implant size between preoperative CT-based planning and the actual implants used intraoperatively for total hip arthroplasty

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注全髋关节置换术中植入物尺寸的一致性，未涉及生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析。
llm.why_not_core: Does not quantify femur stress/strain, micromotion, or implant-bone interface mechanics; no FEA or patient-specific biomechanical modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析术前CT规划与实际植入物尺寸不一致的因素
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析术前CT计划与术中植入尺寸的差异
summary_zh.result: 发现某些因素导致尺寸不一致

summary_en.motivation: To identify factors contributing to discrepancies in implant size between preoperative CT-based planning and actual intraoperative use in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis comparing preoperative CT plans with intraoperative implant sizes.
summary_en.result: Several factors were found to be associated with size mismatch.
summary_en.validation: Validated with patient clinical data from actual surgeries.
